value.rationale: Exact necessary-and-sufficient lower-tail condition, valid for arbitrary iid distributions with mass arbitrarily near 0, classifies almost-sure GW witnessing in a natural infinitely branching star and has the sharp ℓ1 corollary for uniform truth degrees. It demonstrates distinct behavior of almost-every valuation and every valuation, handles all modal nestings, and supplies quantitative late-exception bound.
